parts.technique: Vectors: position vector, constant velocity, distance from origin
parts.reason: Uses position vectors, vector addition with constant velocity, and magnitude of vector (distance) - all covered by P10.1-P10.4 and M7.3 (constant acceleration/velocity in vector form). No excluded concept involved.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Conservation of momentum in a collision
parts.reason: Requires conservation of momentum, a concept not mentioned in any 9MA0 statement (impulse/momentum related concepts are listed among concepts no statement covers). No statement mentions momentum conservation.

parts.label: b
parts.reason: Impulse is explicitly listed among concepts that no 9MA0 statement covers, and this part depends on part (a)'s momentum result too.

parts.technique: Resolving forces with friction (F ≤ μR / F = μR), constant speed equilibrium
parts.reason: Directly matches M8.6 (limiting friction, F=μR model when moving) combined with resolving forces (M8.2/M8.4). Standard in-spec topic.

parts.technique: Moments of forces on a rigid beam (uniform rod), equilibrium
parts.reason: Matches M9.1 directly, which covers moments in simple static contexts including beam/rod problems.

parts.label: a
parts.reason: Directly matches M7.2 which covers interpreting/using velocity-time graphs including gradient and area under graph, and sketching such graphs is a natural extension.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Constant acceleration equations (suvat) using areas under speed-time graph
parts.reason: Matches M7.2 (area under v-t graph as displacement) and M7.3 (constant acceleration formulae); solving for unknown time using distances is standard suvat/kinematics graph work.

parts.label: a

parts.reason: Matches M7.3 (constant acceleration formulae) and M8.3 (motion under gravity, value of g), standard projectile vertical motion.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: suvat for speed on hitting ground
parts.reason: Same constant acceleration/gravity motion as part (a); covered by M7.3/M8.3.

parts.label: c
parts.reason: Same constant acceleration motion under gravity; covered by M7.3/M8.3.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Resolving forces on inclined plane with friction to find normal reaction
parts.reason: Matches M8.6 (F≤μR/limiting friction) and M8.4 guidance which explicitly extends to inclined-plane problems requiring resolving forces.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Resolving forces on inclined plane to find applied force P
parts.reason: Same inclined plane friction/resolving context as (a), matching M8.4 guidance and M8.6.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Newton's second law for connected particles over a pulley to find tension
parts.reason: Directly matches M8.4 guidance which explicitly includes connected particle problems with smooth pulleys.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Newton's second law to find acceleration of connected particles
parts.reason: Follows directly from the pulley/connected particles setup covered by M8.4 and M8.2.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Kinematics: suvat before string breaks then projectile/free fall motion under gravity to find time to hit floor
parts.reason: Uses constant acceleration formulae (M7.3) and motion under gravity (M8.3) for free particle after string breaks; no excluded concept (not momentum/impulse, no vector projectile requiring inverse square law etc).
